messages:
Priya: quick async—gate review for Sprint 28. Need quick decisions: launch order for v2-routing vs embed-cache; spec signoff for latency SLOs; smoke test owner.

Alex: skimmed runtime perf this AM. Overall looks good but 99.9% has a couple of outliers on long sequences (~16k). Sending a tiny PR with a kernel fallback; will run perf after. Link to run: https://perf/reports/1879

Jordan: dropped inline comments on the spec (https://docs/rdw/specs/sprint28). Added a section about error budget and suggested fallback policy. Also added a sample rollback command we can copy to runbooks.

Riley: I can own smoke tests. Need test creds + a mock customer payload (one with embedded history + large context). @Priya can you attach the vector?

Sam: rollout suggestion: (1) embed-cache small subset, (2) v2-routing canary with traffic cap 5%, (3) parallel monitoring window, (4) full rollout. Keeps latency risk isolated.

Priya: short checklist I'm proposing:
```
- Alex: PR for kernel fallback + perf run
- Jordan: update spec with rollback snippet and runbook link
- Riley: smoke test run + report (include logs)
- Sam: create a canary timeline and rollback criteria
```

Priya: assigning: @Alex @Jordan @Riley @Sam — if no objections by EOD we'll plan a canary tomorrow 10:00 PT. :thumbsup:

Devops-bot: smoke test slot reserved: 2025-08-22 10:00 PT (id: smoke-1879). Please confirm here to lock the slot.

Riley: confirmed — I'll run smoke and post a short pass/fail + logs link here.

Alex: PR opened: https://git/repo/PR/342 — perf run queued (will post numbers once done).

Jordan: spec updated with rollback snippet and a tiny example command. PTAL.

Priya: thanks all. If anything blocks, ping #eng-oncall and drop it in this thread so we can triage quickly.
